title: Exploring Compositional Visual Generation with Latent Classifier Guidance
property: face attributes composed with AND and NOT
reads: One global semantic latent vector (StyleGAN2 w_s or Diffusion Autoencoder semantic latent) through a linear classifier, with no text, spatial map or image.
trained_on: Latent DDIM on 100,000 w_s vectors; linear classifiers on clean w_s with StyleFlow latent-label pairs; Diffusion Autoencoder models reused pre-trained.
gradient_enters: Unconditional latent score plus a weighted sum of classifier log-probability gradients, justified by assuming the conditions are independent; weights are not printed.
unseen: no: a new attribute needs a newly trained classifier, and unseen classes are future work.
headline: For gender + smile + age on StyleGAN2, FID (lower is better) is 22.46 linear and 26.49 diffusion against 22.03 for LACE-ODE; age accuracy is 0.863 against 0.925.
copy_or_avoid: Avoid citing it as proof of the summed-log design: the printed proof covers one condition and needs independence given x_t; copy its linear baseline and pairwise correlation check (inferred).
model: StyleGAN2 W_s with latent DDIM; Diffusion Autoencoder

disagreements.paper_says: The printed proof is for a single condition and says the multi-condition case can be easily extended.
